      "voiceInputRequestBodyTemplate": "{\"common\":{\"app_id\":\"{appId}\"},\"business\":{\"language\":\"{lang}\",\"domain\":\"iat\",\"accent\":\"mandarin\",\"dwa\":\"wpgs\"},\"data\":{\"status\":0,\"format\":\"{format}\",\"encoding\":\"{encoding}\"}}",
      "voiceInputAudioBodyTemplate": "{\"data\":{\"status\":1,\"format\":\"{format}\",\"encoding\":\"{encoding}\",\"audio\":\"{audioData}\"}}",
      "voiceInputUrlTemplate": "{protocol}{host}{path}?authorization={signature}&date={date}&host={host}",
      "voiceResponseExtractor": "{{if data.result && data.result.pgs === \"apd\"}}resultText += resultTextTemp;{{/if}}{{resultTextTemp = getValueByPath(data, \"result.ws[].cw[0].w\");}}"
    };
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    // Dynamically obtain parameters
    // ---------------
    getAiConfig().then(response => {
      setAiConfig(response);
    });
    // Custom request action
    // ---------------
    // If the sent message contains the characters "image" or "img", the streaming mode will be disabled,
    // //one or more custom fetch requests will be made, and an image "<img />" will be returned
    setCustomRequest(() => {
      return async (message, config, customMethods, conversationHistory) => {
        if (typeof message === 'string' && (message.includes('image') || message.includes('img'))) {
          // set streaming mode
          config.requestBody.stream = false;
          // if using stream mode, set it to "true"
          const response = await fetch(config.apiUrl, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: config.headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(config.requestBody)
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            const _errInfo = `[ERROR] HTTP Error ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`;
            return {
              content: _errInfo,
              isStream: false
            };
          }
          // if using stream mode
          /*
          return {
          content: response,
          isStream: true
          };
          */
          const jsonResponse = await response.json();
          let result = jsonResponse.choices[0].message.content + '<img src="data:image/png;base64," width="150" height="100" />';
          return {
            content: result,
            isStream: false
          };
        }
        return {
          content: null,
          isStream: false
        };
      };
    });
  }, []);
  return <>

    const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleString();
    const _mergedText = randomMergedText[Math.floor(Math.random() * randomMergedText.length)];

      const {systemPrompt} = _oldData;
      setContextData({
        systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
        mergedText: _mergedText
      });
      alert('The "mergedText" field of the setting context succeeded: ' + JSON.stringify({
        systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
        mergedText: _mergedText
      }));
    }

            <Chatbox bubble={false} contentRef={aichatRef} verbose={aiConfig.verbose} baseUrl={"http://localhost:11434"} apiKey={aiConfig.APIKey} token={() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('DEMO');
  }} customMethods={customMethods} onInputCallback={async input => {
    return input.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br />');
  }} renderParser={async input => {
    // const res = await markedParse(input);
    // return res;
    return input;
  }} nameFormatter={input => {
    return input;
  }} requestConfig={{
    apiUrl: aiConfig.apiUrl,
    requestBody: aiConfig.requestBody,
    responseExtractor: aiConfig.responseBody
  }} headerConfig={aiConfig.headerConfig} customRequest={customRequest} model={aiConfig.modelName1} reasoningSwitchLabel={aiConfig.reasoningSwitchLabel} sendLoadingLabel={aiConfig.sendLoadingLabel} placeholder={aiConfig.placeholder} noDataPlaceholder={aiConfig.noDataPlaceholder} answerName={aiConfig.answerName} questionName={aiConfig.questionName} questionNameIcon={aiConfig.questionNameIcon} answerNameIcon={aiConfig.answerNameIcon} sendLabel={aiConfig.sendLabel} bubbleLabel={aiConfig.bubbleLabel} contextData={contextData} requestBodyFormatter={async (body, context, conversationHistory) => {
    if (body.messages && Array.isArray(body.messages)) {
      // Modify the content in the messages array
      const modifiedMessages = body.messages.map(msg => {
        if (msg.role === 'user') {
          return {
            ...msg,
            content: `${msg.content}`
          };
        }
        return msg;
      });
      /*++++++++++++++++ Contextual reasoning ++++++++++++++++++++++*/
      // add conversation history
      conversationHistory.forEach((item, index) => {
        if (index < conversationHistory.length - 1) {
          modifiedMessages.unshift({
            role: "assistant",
            content: item.content
          });
        }
      });
      /*++++++++++++++++ /Contextual reasoning ++++++++++++++++++++++*/
      // custom merged text
      if (context.mergedText) {
        modifiedMessages.unshift({
          role: "assistant",
          content: `${context.mergedText}`
        });
      }
      // Add a certain style to your answers
      if (context.systemPrompt) {
        modifiedMessages.unshift({
          role: "system",
          content: `${context.systemPrompt}`
        });
      }
      // Returns a new request body containing the modified messages
      return {
        ...body,
        messages: modifiedMessages
      };
    }
    // If there is no messages field, return the original request body
    return body;
  }} onInputChange={(controlRef, val) => {
    console.log('onInputChange: ', val);
  }} onChunk={(controlRef, lastContent, conversationHistory) => {
    console.log('onChunk: ', lastContent, conversationHistory);
  }} onComplete={(controlRef, lastContent, conversationHistory) => {
    console.log('onComplete: ', lastContent, conversationHistory);
  }} newChatButton={aiConfig.newChatButton ? JSON.parse(aiConfig.newChatButton) : undefined} toolkitButtons={aiConfig.toolkitButtons ? JSON.parse(aiConfig.toolkitButtons) : undefined} showCopyBtn={true} autoCopyReply={false} copiedContentFormatter={input => {
    // Convert HTML text to plain text
    return input.replace(/(<([^>]+)>)/ig, '');
  }} onCopyCallback={res => {
    if (res.success) {
      // Text copied to clipboard
      alert(res.message);
    } else {
      // Failed to copy text
      alert(res.message);
    }
  }} voiceConfig={{
    enableVoiceInput: aiConfig.enableVoiceInput,
    holdToTalk: aiConfig.holdToTalk,
    voiceInputLang: aiConfig.voiceInputLang,
    voiceInputAppId: aiConfig.voiceInputAppId,
    voiceInputApiKey: aiConfig.voiceInputApiKey,
    voiceInputApiSecret: aiConfig.voiceInputApiSecret,
    voiceInputSampleRate: aiConfig.voiceInputSampleRate,
    voiceInputFormat: aiConfig.voiceInputFormat,
    voiceInputEncoding: aiConfig.voiceInputEncoding,
    voiceInputIdleTimeoutSeconds: aiConfig.voiceInputIdleTimeoutSeconds,
    voiceInputEndTimeoutSeconds: aiConfig.voiceInputEndTimeoutSeconds,
    voiceInputHost: aiConfig.voiceInputHost,
    voiceInputPath: aiConfig.voiceInputPath,
    voiceInputProtocol: aiConfig.voiceInputProtocol,
    voiceInputHmacAlgorithm: aiConfig.voiceInputHmacAlgorithm,
    voiceInputHashAlgorithm: aiConfig.voiceInputHashAlgorithm,
    voiceInputRequestBodyTemplate: aiConfig.voiceInputRequestBodyTemplate,
    voiceInputAudioBodyTemplate: aiConfig.voiceInputAudioBodyTemplate,
    voiceInputUrlTemplate: aiConfig.voiceInputUrlTemplate,
    voiceResponseExtractor: aiConfig.voiceResponseExtractor,
    // Custom signature generator (implementation depends on external crypto libraries)
    generateVoiceSignature: async params => {
      const {host, path, date, apiKey, apiSecret} = params;
      const algorithm = "hmac-sha256";
      const headers = "host date request-line";
      // Compose the string for signing
      const signatureOrigin = `host: ${host}\ndate: ${date}\nGET /v2/iat HTTP/1.1`;
      const signatureSha = CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(signatureOrigin, apiSecret);
      const signature = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(signatureSha);
      // Build the authorization string
      const authorizationOrigin = `api_key="${apiKey}", algorithm="${algorithm}", headers="${headers}", signature="${signature}"`;
      // Return Base64 encoded authorization string
      return btoa(authorizationOrigin);
    },
    onVoiceInputStart: () => {
      // Add UI prompts or visual indicators here
      console.log('🎤 Recording started...');
    },
    onVoiceInputEnd: text => {
      // 'text' contains the recognized content and is automatically filled into the textarea
      console.log('✅ Recording ended. Result:', text);
      // Automatically submit the message
      aichatRef.current?.sendMsg();
    },
    onVoiceInputError: error => {
      console.error('❌ Voice input error:', error);
      alert('Speech recognition failed: ' + error.message);
    },
    onVoiceInputInterrupt: () => {
      console.log('⏹️ Voice input interrupted');
    }
  }} />
        </>;
};

Speech recognition"}</_components.h3>{"\n"}<_components.ul>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"A separate microphone button will appear next to the send button"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"Clicking the microphone button will start recording"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"While recording, the microphone button shows an animated recording indicator"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"Clicking the button again will stop recording and automatically recognize the speech"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"The recognized text will be automatically filled into the input field"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"The original send button remains unchanged and works as before"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"You can then send the message normally or continue editing"}</_components.li>{"\n"}</_components.ul>{"\n"}<_components.h2 id="general">{"General"}</_components.h2>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"Use the chat area alone, without bubbles + read remote parameter configuration"}</_components.p>{"\n"}<br />{"\n"}{"\n"}<Demo1 />{"\n"}<_components.details><_components.summary><i className="fa-brands fa-js px-2" />{" Show Code"}</_components.summary><_components.pre data-language="js" data-theme="default" hasCopyCode><_components.code data-language="js" data-theme="default"><_components.span className="line"><_components.span style={{
